events.title: Christmas Tree Lighting at Plant Riverside District
events.blurb: The riverfront district lights its tree in MLK Park, the official grand opening of the Savannah Christmas Market.
events.blurbEs: El distrito junto al río enciende su árbol en MLK Park, la gran inauguración oficial del Savannah Christmas Market.

events.title: Eastern Wharf Holiday Kickoff & Savannah Lighted Boat Parade
events.blurb: Food trucks, photos with Santa (5–7 p.m.) and the Fabulous Equinox Orchestra, then decorated boats parade from Eastern Wharf to the Talmadge Bridge and back from 7 to 9 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Food trucks, fotos con Santa (5–7 p. m.) y la Fabulous Equinox Orchestra; luego, de 7 a 9 p. m., los barcos decorados desfilan desde Eastern Wharf hasta el puente Talmadge y de regreso.

events.title: The Nutcracker
events.blurb: South Carolina Ballet brings its holiday production to the Savannah Civic Center for one performance.
events.blurbEs: El South Carolina Ballet trae su producción navideña al Savannah Civic Center en una sola función.

events.title: MIXED: Where Music Meets Mixology
events.blurb: An evening of live music paired with craft cocktails at the Starland-area venue.
events.blurbEs: Una noche de música en vivo con cócteles de autor en este local de la zona de Starland.

events.title: Big Awesome Improv Comedy
events.blurb: Savannah's weekly Saturday-night improv show, about 90 minutes with an intermission; beer and wine are sold. The price includes fees, with $19.20 student tickets.
events.blurbEs: El show semanal de improvisación de los sábados en Savannah, de unos 90 minutos con intermedio; se vende cerveza y vino. El precio incluye cargos; boletos de estudiante a $19.20.

events.title: Jepson Center & Telfair Children's Art Museum
events.blurb: Telfair's modern art museum, with a hands-on children's art museum inside. One ticket covers all three Telfair sites for seven days, and they reopen Friday after closing for Thanksgiving.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte moderno de Telfair, con un museo de arte infantil interactivo adentro. Un boleto cubre las tres sedes de Telfair durante siete días; reabren el viernes tras cerrar por Thanksgiving.

events.title: Bonaventure Cemetery After Dark
events.blurb: A guided evening tour of Savannah's famous oak-lined cemetery, offered for Thanksgiving weekend.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido guiado al anochecer por el famoso cementerio de Savannah bordeado de robles, ofrecido el fin de semana de Thanksgiving.

events.title: Forsyth Park
events.addr: Gaston St & Whitaker St, Savannah, GA 31401
events.blurb: Savannah's 30-acre park with the famous fountain, under live oaks and Spanish moss.
events.blurbEs: El parque de 12 hectáreas de Savannah con su famosa fuente, bajo robles y musgo español.
